en_title: CD Projekt Has Officially Begun Work on Project Hadar, but It's Not in Pre-Production Yet
subtitle: 新世界初具轮廓
opus_summary: CDPR已完成新IP《Project Hadar》的世界观构想，团队正式着手开发游戏，但尚未进入预制作阶段。目前团队超过30人，计划在年底前扩充至50名开发者。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt Red, the Polish developer best known for its amazing RPG series The Witcher and Cyberpunk 2077 , has officially finished imagining up a new world for us to play in. The “world vision” stage for its new IP, Project Hadar, has been completed and work has officially begun on turning those concepts into a video game.
paragraphs.cn: 凭借出色的《巫师》RPG系列和《赛博朋克2077》而闻名的波兰开发商CDPR，已经正式完成了一个供玩家游玩的全新世界的构想。其新IP《Project Hadar》的「世界观构想」阶段现已结束，团队正式开始将这些概念做成游戏。

paragraphs.en: "This has been our biggest undertaking to date, taking us several years, but at this point we can say we have a coherent vision for this world and its key elements,” said Joint CEO Michał Nowakowski . “The team has begun work on the game, although it's not yet in pre-production.”
paragraphs.cn: 联席首席执行官Michał Nowakowski表示：「这是我们迄今为止规模最大的一次尝试，花了我们数年时间。不过，如今我们可以说，对于这个世界及其核心要素，我们已经形成了一套连贯的构想。团队已经开始开发游戏，不过项目尚未进入预制作阶段。」

paragraphs.en: In September, CD Projekt Red said it was staffing up for Project Hadar, with a team over 30 strong with plans "to hire more, up to 50 developers by the end of this year. But what is it? In June, a new job advert teased what to expect , calling for an engineering director who would help “push the envelope for the next, immersive game in the Hadar world, creating an emotional, open-world experience that will stay with gamers.” Open-world confirmed!
paragraphs.cn: 今年9月，CDPR表示正在为《Project Hadar》扩充人手，团队已有30多人，并计划「继续招聘，到今年年底将开发人员增至50人」。但这究竟是一款怎样的游戏？今年6月，一则新的招聘启事透露了些许线索：团队正在招募一名工程总监，协助「推动《Hadar》世界下一款沉浸式游戏的发展，打造一款情感丰富、令玩家难忘的开放世界体验」。开放世界，确认了！

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt Red is of course currently hard at work making The Witcher 4, which is the next game on the studio’s slate due out 2028. Before that, though, a third major expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, titled Songs of the Past, is scheduled for release next year. Developed by Fool’s Theory, a team of former CD Projekt developers, the expansion aims to bridge the gap between The Witcher 3 and the next game in the series, starring Geralt’s adopted daughter, Ciri.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，CDPR目前正全力开发《巫师4》。这是工作室接下来将推出的游戏，计划于2028年发售。不过，在此之前，《巫师3：狂猎》的第三部大型扩展《旧时曲》计划于明年推出。这部扩展由前CDPR开发者组成的Fool’s Theory团队开发，旨在衔接《巫师3》与系列下一部作品；后者将由杰洛特的养女希里担任主角。

paragraphs.en: After that comes Cyberpunk 2, the follow-up to Cyberpunk 2077. And let's not forget that CD Projekt intends to release the new The Witcher 3 trilogy in the space of six years. Assuming CD Projekt hits 2028 for The Witcher 4, and the company sticks to its ambitious release strategy for this new The Witcher trilogy , we could see The Witcher 5 in 2031 and The Witcher 6 in 2034. Where Hadar fits in with all that is anyone's guess.
paragraphs.cn: 之后还有《赛博朋克2077》的续作《赛博朋克2》。也别忘了，CDPR打算在六年内推出《巫师》新三部曲。假如《巫师4》能按计划于2028年发售，而且公司坚持这套雄心勃勃的新三部曲发行策略，我们或许会在2031年看到《巫师5》，在2034年看到《巫师6》。至于《Hadar》会排在其中哪个位置，现在谁也说不准。

paragraphs.en: We know nothing about Project Hadar’s world or setting, but it’ll be cool to see what the wonderful minds at CDPR think up — especially as it’ll be designed first and foremost to support a sprawling RPG. I do selfishly wish CDPR would do one more license though. Give us a good Game of Thrones video game. Please. You could call it Project Hodor.
paragraphs.cn: 我们对《Project Hadar》的世界和设定一无所知，但能看看CDPR这些才华横溢的开发者会构思出什么，想必很有意思——尤其是，这个世界在设计之初就会优先考虑如何承载一款规模庞大的RPG。不过，出于私心，我确实希望CDPR再做一款授权改编游戏。给我们一款优秀的《权力的游戏》电子游戏吧。拜托了。你们可以把它叫作《Project Hodor》。

paragraphs.en: The next series of the anime based on CDPR and Pondsmith’s shared world is coming to Netflix on October 20. You can check out our interview with the creator of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 for the lowdown.
paragraphs.cn: 基于CDPR与Pondsmith共享世界观打造的动画，其新一部系列将于10月20日登陆Netflix。

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in CD Project Land, The Witcher 3 just got a remaster on consoles and PC, which saw the iconic RPG get a makeover to tide people over until the expansion. There were some issues with the new visuals, particularly heavy bloom in The Witcher 3 remaster , but CDPR fixed its prized goose sharpish.
paragraphs.cn: 再来看CDPR的其他消息：《巫师3》刚刚在主机和PC上推出了画面重制版，让这款经典RPG焕新面貌，供玩家在等待扩展推出期间游玩。新版画面出现了一些问题，尤其是《巫师3》重制版的泛光效果过强，不过CDPR很快就为这棵摇钱树修好了问题。
